Kit summary

Ruinous Swinging StrikeBasic
Deals 180% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to reduce 30% DEF of the target for 2 turns.
Bright AheadActiveExclusive Lv.1
Restores all allies‘ HP by 10% HP of Max HP, and increases their Turn Meters by 10%.
Iron-Faced Shield Lv.1Bright Ahead cleanses 3 layers of DoT debuff from all allies, increasing all allies' Turn Meter by 4% for every 1 layer of DoT debuff cleansed.
Valiant CounterattackPassiveExclusive Lv.3
Anton gains 1 layer of [Valor] at the beginning of each wave or at the start of his turn. Anton consumes 1 layer of [Valor] and inflicts [Stun] on the attacker for 1 turn when the lost HP caused by single Direct DMG exceeds 24% of his Max HP during the validity period of [Valor]. This [Stun] effect cannot be blocked or cleansed. Besides, the same effect triggers when self takes Fatal DMG.
Iron-Faced Shield Lv.3Increases the layers of [Valor] Anton gains at the beginning of each wave to 3. Anton can only have up to 3 layers of [Valor].
Sacred ShieldActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies a [Shield] by 40% of Anton's Max HP for 2 turns.
Iron-Faced Shield Lv.2Sacred Shield additionally grants all allies [Consolidation I] for 2 turns.
